MESSAGE.ERROR_PORT_IN_USE: Port %s is already in use. JP Radio cannot start.
MESSAGE.STATION_LOGO_CLEAR: Station logo cache cleared. This takes effect after the plugin restarts.
MESSAGE.RESTART_FAILED_MESSAGE: The plugin could not be restarted.
MESSAGE.RESTART_MODAL_MESSAGE: Changes have been made that require the JP Radio plugin to be restarted. Please click the restart button below.
MESSAGE.WARNING_SWITCH_LIVE1: This program hasn't aired yet, so playback switched to live.
MESSAGE.WARNING_SWITCH_LIVE2: This program is currently on air, so playback switched to live.

UI_SETTINGS.PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Japanese radio relay server for Volumio3
UI_SETTINGS.SERVICE_PORT_DOC: Enter the service port number (1024-65535). The default value is 9000.
UI_SETTINGS.NETWORK_DELAY_DOC: The measured delay (seconds) of live streaming. Default is 100.
UI_SETTINGS.RADIKO_ACCOUNT_USER_DOC: This is the username of your Radiko account
UI_SETTINGS.RADIKO_ACCOUNT_PASS_DOC: This is the password of your Radiko account
UI_SETTINGS.ALBUMART_SELECT_DOC:
Configure how album art is fetched.
　Default: Program image
UI_SETTINGS.STATION_LOGO_DOC: Deletes the locally cached station logo images. They will be re-fetched the next time the plugin restarts.
UI_SETTINGS.BROWSE_SETTING_DESC: Configure what happens when you select a station or program in the browse screen.
UI_SETTINGS.BROWSE_LIVE_DOC:
Configure the action when selecting a live station.
　Default: Play
UI_SETTINGS.BROWSE_TIMEFREE_DOC:
Configure the action when selecting a Time-Free program.
　Default: Play
UI_SETTINGS.PROGRAM_PERIOD_FROM_DOC:
Number of past days (0-30) to show when opening the timetable.
　Default: 7
UI_SETTINGS.PROGRAM_PERIOD_TO_DOC:
Number of future days (0-6) to show when opening the timetable.
　Default: 0 (Today)
UI_SETTINGS.TIME_FORMAT_DOC: Configure the date/time format shown on the playback screen and timetable.
UI_SETTINGS.TEMPO_DOC: Sets the playback speed for Time-Free programs. Does not affect live playback.
UI_SETTINGS.RADIKO_AREAS_DESC: Choose which areas' stations to show in the live/time-free station lists.
